description: Compute the lexicographically maximum rank-count signature by Irving's rank-phase reduced-graph algorithm.

source.title: Ranked Matching
source.primary_method_reference: R. W. Irving, T. Kavitha, K. Mehlhorn, D. Michail, and K. Paluch, Rank-maximal matchings, ACM Transactions on Algorithms 2(4), 602-610 (2006).
source.primary_method_location: Sections 2.2 and 2.4: even/odd/unreachable classes and the per-rank reduced-graph procedure.
source.algorithm_attribution: Rank-phase reduced-graph method using even/odd/unreachable decomposition and maximum matching at each rank.
source.implementation_status: Bounded clean-room profile; no source code or protected text is reused.

contract.operation: Find the lexicographically maximum rank-count signature of a matching in a ranked bipartite applicant-post graph.
contract.rank_objective: For signature (s1,...,sR), maximize s1; subject to that maximize s2; continue through sR.
contract.input_semantics: Equal positive edge ranks encode ties. Applicants may omit rank levels. Every applicant lists at least one post. Unmatched applicants are allowed and are not given private dummy posts.
contract.phase_method: At phase i, take a maximum matching in the surviving graph through rank i; classify vertices E/O/U by alternating paths from all unmatched vertices; delete active O-O and O-U edges; permanently delete higher-rank edges incident to O or U; then introduce the next rank and repeat.
contract.bounded_matching_subroutine: For this tiny profile, each phase recomputes a maximum matching by exhaustive assignment enumeration, with unmatched encoded after all real post IDs. This changes only the bounded maximum-matching subroutine, not the phase reduction or rank-signature objective.
contract.output_encoding: [R,s1,...,sR] as little-endian signed i64 values; malformed input returns -1.
contract.input_order: Preference records are normalized into an applicant/post rank matrix; record order does not affect the result.

edge_rules: each applicant has at least one edge

workspace.meaning: Fixed 4x4 rank/blocked matrices, eight alternating-forest labels, assignments, and bounded enumeration state.
